_comment_ignore_compile: The refreeze's load-bearing design property (§7.2): slither NEVER invokes a compiler. `forge build --build-info` runs first under the accepted Foundry v1.5.0 / solc 0.8.28 pins, and slither parses out/build-info/*.json. Static analysis and compilation therefore cannot diverge, and solc-select is never exercised.
_comment_filter_paths: vendor/ is byte-identical upstream source under an immutable census whose drift gate fails closed on a one-byte change (refreeze §7.4). VUX cannot act on a finding there without breaking the census, so those findings are excluded from REPORTING. They are still PARSED — slither must resolve the imports to build a correct call graph.
_comment_detectors: No detector is disabled and no severity class is suppressed. The sprint target is `no unexplained or improperly dispositioned finding`, not a cosmetically empty report — every finding is dispositioned by key in tools/static-analysis/triage-baseline.json.
